title: Drone strike on market in disputed Sudan border region kills at least 153

article.title: Drone strike on market in disputed Sudan border region kills at least 153
article.summary: A drone strike on a market in Abyei, a border region disputed by Sudan and South Sudan, hit a nearby fuel depot, killing at least 153 people, a local official said on Tuesday. Yohanna Akol Ngor, the Abyei administration’s caretaker information minister, blamed Sudan’s military for Monday’s attack on Amiet Market, north of Abyei town.
